title: Corner post, 0.15 m square
description: A square rendered post that turns a facade through a right angle at an outside corner. It is one storey high and as thick as the wall modules. A run of modules ends on its left face, and the next run starts on the far face, turned a quarter turn.

reference_pack.value_or_path: Typical sizes for a two-storey Tokyo house, chosen for this test. Not measured from a real building, so record dimension_source as "estimated".
Use only library materials from assets/mat/. Give each glTF material the library ID as its name and the values in that material.json. No custom materials and no textures in this test.
The post fills a box from x = 0 to 0.15, y = 0 to 2.8 and z = -0.15 to 0. Its two outer faces are z = 0 (facing +Z) and x = 0.15 (facing +X).
See connector_frames in this task. Each gives a connector's position and the directions of its +Z and +Y, in the asset's own axes (+X right, +Y up, +Z front). The validator checks them.

connector_frames.name: conn_facade_edge_b_01
connector_frames.note: Receives the run that ends at this corner.

connector_frames.name: conn_facade_edge_a_01
connector_frames.note: Starts the next run, which faces +X and continues towards -Z.
